title: The Small Things
sections: Verse 1
Late afternoon comes rolling in
and lays itself across the floor
Sammie takes his post again
just left of the sliding glass door
A bumblebee goes bouncing by
fat and gold and full of sound
Maggie hits the glass with both paws
and doesn't even slow down
Chorus 1
And I think somebody's watching this
the same way I do from the couch
I think somebody's laughing too
at old Sammie in his crouch
that the bees keep flying and the cats keep trying
and the afternoon holds still
I think God likes the small things
I think He always will
Verse 2
There's no moral to the story here
no lesson I can name
just Sammie and Maggie doing their work
and the glass doing the same
The light comes sideways through the door
and turns the whole room gold
and I think I'll remember this
long after I am old
Chorus 2
And I think somebody's watching this
the same way I do from the couch
I think somebody's laughing too
at old Sammie in his crouch
that the bees keep flying and the cats keep trying
and the afternoon holds still
I think God likes the small things
I think He always will
Bridge
Nobody wrote this down
nobody sent me here
I just sat down on a Tuesday
and the holy showed up clear
Last Chorus
And I think somebody's watching this
the same way I do from the couch
I think somebody's laughing too
at old Sammie in his crouch
that the bees keep flying and the cats keep trying
and the afternoon holds still
I think God likes the small things
I think He always will
